description: Acquire and replay official Census code/title references for six explicitly bound NAICS editions.
retry: No automatic network retries; rerun with a new run ID after a failed operation. Retained releases replay without network.
checkpoint: Run-scoped source files and receipt; no partial resume. Manifest published last after complete replay validation.
idempotency: Content-addressed immutable releases; validate identical existing release and reuse it. No current pointer.
cancellation: AbortSignal cancels requests and bounded parsing; terminal run receipt records cancellation; unpublished staging is isolated and no shared lock is held.
retention_profile: Retain public native and derived immutable releases and operation receipts within datahub.
